prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>: young East Asian woman, long dark hair in a low side ponytail, long beige-grey cardigan over a light top. Her face, eye shape, eyebrows and hairstyle follow <Picture 1> exactly.
<Subject 2> is the apartment environment in <Picture 2>: a small living room at night with plain light walls, a wooden desk, a lamp with a pleated shade giving warm light, a beige sofa and a tall window with rain on the glass.

summary:
[reference generation] At night in <Subject 2>, <Subject 1> sits at the wooden desk under the warm lamp and reads a handwritten letter; a quiet, thoughtful moment.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - her face, facial proportions, eye shape, eyebrows, low side ponytail and long beige-grey cardigan are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the light walls, wooden desk, pleated lamp shade, beige sofa and rainy window are retained as the background.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic, live-action short-drama shot at night, lit mainly by the warm desk lamp, with soft shadows, natural skin texture and realistic colors.
[Shot 1] A medium close-up from the front frames <Subject 1> from the chest up as she sits at the wooden desk of <Subject 2>; the camera is at her eye level, a little to the left of the lamp, and her face fills a large part of the frame and is in sharp focus. She wears her long beige-grey cardigan over a light top, and her long dark hair is gathered in a low side ponytail over one shoulder. The lamp with the pleated shade stands at the right edge of the frame and lights the side of her face warmly, leaving a soft golden highlight on her cheekbone and a gentle shadow along her jaw. On the desk in front of her lie an opened envelope and a ceramic mug, slightly out of focus at the lower edge of the frame. Her skin shows natural texture and fine pores, her eyelashes are sharp, and a small moist highlight from the lamp shines in each eye. Behind her, softly out of focus but recognisable, the room of <Subject 2> continues: the plain light wall, the beige sofa, and the tall window with raindrops running down the glass and blurred city lights outside. She holds a handwritten letter in both hands at chest height, the paper facing her. Her eyes move along the lines from left to right in small steps; she blinks once. At one line her eyes stop; she pauses, her eyebrows draw together very slightly, then relax. She lowers the letter a little, her gaze drops to the desk for a moment, and she takes a slow, quiet breath; the corners of her mouth soften but she does not smile. Both eyes stay level and symmetrical, pupils aimed at the same point, and her facial proportions stay unchanged; she never looks into the lens. Her lips stay closed; she does not speak. The camera holds a static shot. There is no text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Rain tapping on the window, a soft paper rustle as she lowers the letter, and her quiet breath in a calm room.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
